title: A page-anchored wrapTopAndBottom shape in the header wraps the later strip lines in page coordinates
source: Letter, pgMar top 720, header 1440, header paragraph 1 anchors a 2 x 0.5 in rect at page y 90pt (wrapTopAndBottom) + "HDRLINE 1", then two more lines; Word for Mac PDF: line 1 at 72.05, lines 2-3 at 126.05 / 139.49 under the shape (90..126), body 152.93

cases.note: guards the strip page position; gen draws strip text 1.1pt low (strip chrome)
72 + line + 36pt shape + two lines; gen 114.57: a wrapTopAndBottom page-anchored shape does not push the strip lines below it (HfObstacle handles side wraps only)
